metadata.description: 32 independent, multi-domain evaluation questions covering technical specs, architecture, cross-document reasoning, unseen competitors, missing perils, and policy contradictions.
metadata.labeling_attribution: Author-generated and code-verified against indexed knowledge base

questions.query: What are the supported network interface protocols and wireless frequencies on the ApexPrint ProX-400?
questions.required_evidence_coverage: Single document or technical connectivity manual
questions.labeling_rationale: Directly documented in ProX-400 user manual connectivity section.

questions.query: What is the physical paper tray capacity of Tray 1, Tray 2, and Tray 3 on the ApexPrint ColorWave-850?
questions.labeling_rationale: Directly documented in ColorWave-850 paper handling specifications.

questions.query: How does the document chunking service split uploaded documents and what overlap is maintained between chunks?
expected_relevant_docs: AI Customer Support Intelligence Platform - Project Dossier.pdf
questions.labeling_rationale: Directly documented in Project Dossier architecture specifications.

questions.query: What distance metric and space configuration are utilized by ChromaDB in this platform?
expected_relevant_docs: AI Customer Support Intelligence Platform - Project Dossier.pdf
questions.labeling_rationale: Directly documented in Project Dossier vector storage architecture.

questions.query: What are the diagnostic steps when the ProX-400 front panel displays blinking amber LED alongside error code E-101?
expected_answerable_claims: Error E-101 corresponds to paper jam in registration sensors
Inspect pickup rollers and remove obstructed media
questions.required_evidence_coverage: Troubleshooting manual Error Code E-101 section
questions.labeling_rationale: Documented in error codes troubleshooting guide.

questions.query: What is the recommended cleaning interval and procedure for the optical laser glass and corona wire?
expected_answerable_claims: Clean corona wire using built-in cleaning slider tab
Wipe laser glass with lint-free microfiber cloth
questions.required_evidence_coverage: Hardware maintenance FAQ and user manual
questions.labeling_rationale: Directly documented in hardware maintenance FAQ.

questions.query: How does the hybrid retrieval engine fuse dense ChromaDB embeddings with sparse BM25 scores using Reciprocal Rank Fusion?
expected_relevant_docs: AI Customer Support Intelligence Platform - Project Dossier.pdf
expected_answerable_claims: Combines dense semantic vector rank with BM25 keyword rank
questions.required_evidence_coverage: Project Dossier Section 3.4 Hybrid Retrieval Engine
questions.labeling_rationale: Fully documented in Project Dossier architecture.

questions.query: Compare the duty cycle, resolution, and ink or toner technology between the ProX-400 and the ColorWave-850.
expected_answerable_claims: ProX-400: monochrome laser, 100,000 pages duty cycle, 1200x1200 dpi
ColorWave-850: wide-format color inkjet, pigment inks, 2400x1200 dpi
questions.required_evidence_coverage: Cross-document synthesis between ProX-400 manual and ColorWave-850 manual
questions.labeling_rationale: Requires multi-document synthesis across two user manuals.

questions.query: How do the document categories selected during upload influence retrieval filtering and prompt assembly in MCP mode?
expected_relevant_docs: AI Customer Support Intelligence Platform - Project Dossier.pdf
expected_answerable_claims: Soft category ranking in hybrid retrieval
questions.labeling_rationale: Cross-subsystem explanation documented in Project Dossier.

questions.query: What is Reciprocal Rank Fusion and what value of k is configured as the rank constant in the hybrid retriever?
expected_relevant_docs: AI Customer Support Intelligence Platform - Project Dossier.pdf
expected_answerable_claims: RRF is a rank-based fusion algorithm
Rank constant k=60 to dampen outlier rankings
questions.labeling_rationale: Documented in technical retrieval architecture.

questions.query: Explain what Multi-Context Prompting is and how it prevents loss-in-the-middle phenomena in customer support answers.
expected_relevant_docs: AI Customer Support Intelligence Platform - Project Dossier.pdf
expected_answerable_claims: MCP structures contexts into labeled category blocks
Mitigates context dilution and attention decay
questions.labeling_rationale: Directly documented in Project Dossier.

questions.query: Does the standard limited warranty cover damage caused by operating the printer outside specified voltage or temperature limits?
expected_answerable_claims: Explicitly excluded: operating hardware outside specified environmental or electrical limits voids coverage
questions.labeling_rationale: Documented as an explicit policy exclusion.

questions.query: What specific consumables are excluded from warranty coverage once their initial yield is depleted?
expected_answerable_claims: Toner cartridges, ink tanks, waste toner containers, and imaging drums are consumable items excluded after initial depletion
questions.labeling_rationale: Documented under consumable exclusions clause.

questions.query: What are the core benchmark metrics achieved by the Customer Support Intelligence Platform in Stage 7B?
expected_relevant_docs: AI Customer Support Intelligence Platform - Project Dossier.pdf
questions.labeling_rationale: Documented in benchmark evaluation chapter.

questions.query: What storage budget constraint was established for the project and how is compliance monitored?
expected_relevant_docs: AI Customer Support Intelligence Platform - Project Dossier.pdf
expected_answerable_claims: Monitored via automated health check in app/services/health.py
Local disk footprint currently under 25 MB
questions.required_evidence_coverage: Project Dossier Section 4 Engineering Decisions & Constraints
questions.labeling_rationale: Documented in engineering constraints section.

questions.query: What five subsystems are evaluated by the automated health check in the backend platform?
expected_relevant_docs: AI Customer Support Intelligence Platform - Project Dossier.pdf
questions.required_evidence_coverage: Project Dossier Section 3.6 System Health Subsystem
questions.labeling_rationale: Documented in system health architecture.

questions.query: Can multiple client workstations on different subnets print to the ColorWave-850 simultaneously?
expected_answerable_claims: Yes, supports concurrent network spooling over TCP/IP Gigabit Ethernet across routed subnets
questions.labeling_rationale: Documented in networking section of user manual.

questions.query: What file formats are supported for document upload in the Customer Support Intelligence Platform?
expected_relevant_docs: AI Customer Support Intelligence Platform - Project Dossier.pdf
questions.labeling_rationale: Documented in ingestion format specifications.

questions.query: What are the print speeds for black and color documents on the EcoTank L3150?
questions.labeling_rationale: Documented in EcoTank technical specifications sheet.

questions.query: How do you perform a network reset to restore factory Wi-Fi settings on the ApexPrint ProX-400?
expected_answerable_claims: Hold network button for 10 seconds until Wi-Fi LED flashes amber
Reboots internal print server to factory defaults
questions.labeling_rationale: Documented in Wi-Fi troubleshooting manual.

questions.query: Can I disassemble and replace the fuser unit myself using hand tools if Error E-204 persists?
expected_answerable_claims: Troubleshooting guide describes opening fuser unit
Warranty policy strictly warns unauthorized disassembly voids warranty
questions.required_evidence_coverage: Cross-category conflict between troubleshooting and warranty
questions.labeling_rationale: Troubleshooting manual explains component access while warranty policy explicitly voids warranty for unauthorized disassembly.

questions.query: Should I bypass the internal power supply if voltage fluctuations occur in the printing environment?
expected_answerable_claims: Warranty voids coverage for electrical modifications or non-OEM power
questions.labeling_rationale: Troubleshooting recommends power conditioning while warranty policy warns tampering with power components terminates warranty.

questions.query: What is the standard warranty period and what is the exact physical mailing address for sending international return merchandise?
expected_answerable_claims: International return physical street address is absent from documentation
questions.required_evidence_coverage: Partial coverage: warranty duration is documented, international return warehouse address is missing
questions.labeling_rationale: Query contains two factual sub-questions; one is documented while the second is absent from the knowledge base.

questions.query: How do you replace the waste toner box on a Ricoh Aficio MP C4503 multi-function copier?
expected_answerable_claims: Abstention due to competitor brand mismatch (Ricoh Aficio vs. ApexPrint)
questions.labeling_rationale: Query targets Ricoh Aficio, an unseen external competitor absent from the knowledge base.

questions.query: What is the procedure for clearing error code 13.00.00 paper jam on a Lexmark CS720 color laser printer?
expected_answerable_claims: Abstention due to competitor brand mismatch (Lexmark CS720 vs. ApexPrint)
questions.labeling_rationale: Query targets Lexmark CS720, an unseen external competitor absent from the knowledge base.

questions.query: What is the duplex printing speed of a Kyocera ECOSYS P3155dn monochrome printer?
expected_answerable_claims: Abstention due to competitor brand mismatch (Kyocera ECOSYS vs. ApexPrint)
questions.labeling_rationale: Query targets Kyocera ECOSYS, an unseen external competitor absent from the knowledge base.

questions.query: Does the ApexPrint warranty cover repairs for damage caused by volcanic eruption ash or toxic chemical spills?
expected_answerable_claims: Retrieved warranty policies do not mention volcanic eruption ash or toxic chemical spills; absence of clause is not proof of inclusion or exclusion
questions.required_evidence_coverage: Warranty policy silent on queried conditions
questions.labeling_rationale: Volcanic eruption ash and toxic chemical spills are unmentioned in warranty documentation.

questions.query: Is liquid spill damage from spilled coffee or tea covered under the standard hardware warranty agreement?
expected_answerable_claims: Warranty policy does not contain clauses defining coverage or exclusion for spilled coffee or tea beverages
questions.required_evidence_coverage: Warranty policy silent on beverage liquid spills
questions.labeling_rationale: Coffee/tea beverage spills are not specified in the warranty agreement.

questions.query: What are the maximum cabin carry-on dimensions and checked baggage weight limits on United Airlines?
expected_answerable_claims: Abstention due to out-of-domain airline topic (sub-threshold similarity)
questions.labeling_rationale: Query has misleading lexical overlap with shipping/packaging box dimensions in printer manual, but targets United Airlines baggage.

questions.query: How do astronomers calculate the orbital velocity of Jupiter's moon Europa?
questions.labeling_rationale: Alien celestial mechanics topic with zero presence in indexed knowledge base.

questions.query: What is the wholesale bulk dealer discount percentage for purchasing 500 units of the ColorWave-850?
expected_answerable_claims: Knowledge base documents hardware technical specifications; wholesale dealer bulk pricing is completely absent
questions.labeling_rationale: Valid in-domain hardware product (ColorWave-850), but commercial dealer wholesale discounts are not in knowledge base.

questions.query: What is the exact AWS EC2 instance type and monthly hosting cost for production Kubernetes deployment of this platform?
expected_relevant_docs: AI Customer Support Intelligence Platform - Project Dossier.pdf
expected_answerable_claims: Dossier documents local deployment and Colab GPU fallback; AWS EC2 Kubernetes production hosting is not documented
questions.required_evidence_coverage: Dossier lacks AWS EC2 cloud pricing
questions.labeling_rationale: Valid in-domain project topic, but cloud deployment hosting on AWS EC2/Kubernetes is absent from the dossier.
